logger.message: #['MERGE_INCOMPLETE | Processed ' ++ (vars.allIdpResults.processedParts default 0) ++ ' of ' ++ (vars.allIdpResults.totalParts default 0) ++ ' parts']

json-logger:logger.doc:name: Log Data Cloud Store Start
json-logger:logger.json-logger:content: #[output application/json --- { correlationId: vars.correlationId, subFlowName: "store-idp-to-datacloud-subflow", step: "DC_STORE_START", partNumber: vars.partNumber, idpStatus: vars.idpExtractedData.status }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- vars.correlationId ++ "_" ++ (vars.partNumber as String default "0")
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- vars.idpExtractedData.extractedData.fields.overallSummary.value default ""
%dw 2.0 output application/java var raw = vars.idpExtractedData.extractedData.fields.overallSummary.value default "{}" --- read(raw, "application/json")

%dw 2.0 output application/java var raw = vars.idpExtractedData.extractedData.fields.overallSummary.value default "{}" var parsed = read(raw, "application/json") var firstDoc = (parsed.documents default [])[0] default {} --- firstDoc.documentType default "Medical Summary"
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- if (vars.idpExtractedData.extractedData.status == "SUCCEEDED") 0.90 else 0.50

%dw 2.0 output application/java --- if (vars.idpExtractedData.status != "SUCCESS") "High" else if ((vars.dcAvgConfidence as Number default 0) >= 0.85) "Low" else if ((vars.dcAvgConfidence as Number default 0) >= 0.60) "Medium" else "High"

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { data: [{ Document_Id: vars.dcDocumentId, Claim_Id: vars.claimId default "", Correlation_Id: vars.correlationId, Document_Type: vars.dcDocumentType, File_Name: vars.idpExtractedData.extractedData.documentName default ((vars.partFileName default "unknown") ++ ".pdf"), Total_Pages: vars.currentPart.pageCount as Number default 0, Processing_Status: vars.idpExtractedData.extractedData.status default "UNKNOWN", Confidence_Score: vars.dcAvgConfidence as Number default 0, AI_Summary: vars.dcOverallSummaryJson default "", Risk_Level: vars.dcRiskLevel, Processed_At: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXXX"}, Account_Id: vars.accountId default "" }] }

logger.doc:name: Log Doc Processing Streaming Insert
logger.message: #['DC_DOC_PROCESSING_INSERT | documentId=' ++ vars.dcDocumentId]

json-logger:logger.doc:name: Log Doc Processing Error
json-logger:logger.message: Failed to insert IDP_Document_Processing__dlm via Streaming API
json-logger:logger.json-logger:content: #[output application/json --- { correlationId: vars.correlationId, partNumber: vars.partNumber, documentId: vars.dcDocumentId, error: error.description, errorType: error.errorType.identifier }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { data: vars.dcExtractedFields map ((field, idx) -> { Field_Id: vars.dcDocumentId ++ "_" ++ (idx as String), Document_Id: vars.dcDocumentId, Claim_Id: vars.claimId default "", Field_Name: field.key as String default "", Field_Value: field.value as String default "", Confidence: vars.dcAvgConfidence as Number default 0.90, Page_Number: 0, Requires_Review: false }) }

logger.doc:name: Log Extracted Fields Streaming Insert
logger.message: #['DC_EXTRACTED_FIELDS_INSERT | fieldCount=' ++ (sizeOf(vars.dcExtractedFields) as String) ++ ' | documentId=' ++ vars.dcDocumentId]

json-logger:logger.doc:name: Log Extracted Fields Error
json-logger:logger.message: Failed to insert IDP_Extracted_Field__dlm via Streaming API
json-logger:logger.json-logger:content: #[output application/json --- { correlationId: vars.correlationId, partNumber: vars.partNumber, documentId: vars.dcDocumentId, fieldCount: sizeOf(vars.dcExtractedFields default []), error: error.description, errorType: error.errorType.identifier }]

logger.doc:name: Log No Fields to Store
logger.message: #['DC_NO_FIELDS | No extracted fields to store for documentId=' ++ vars.dcDocumentId]

json-logger:logger.doc:name: Log Data Cloud Store Complete
json-logger:logger.json-logger:content: #[output application/json --- { correlationId: vars.correlationId, subFlowName: "store-idp-to-datacloud-subflow", step: "DC_STORE_COMPLETE", partNumber: vars.partNumber, documentId: vars.dcDocumentId, fieldCount: sizeOf(vars.dcExtractedFields default []) }]
